name: PreFileEdit - Protect Critical Files
description: Protects critical configuration and data files from unintended modifications

rules.message: ⚠️ You are editing a credentials or secrets file. Ensure no sensitive data is exposed.
⚠️ You are editing core pipeline configuration. Verify changes don't break the pipeline.
⚠️ Dependency changes detected. Run tests after updating requirements.
⚠️ Database file edit detected. Ensure no data corruption occurs.
❌ Setup documentation is protected. Create a new file if you need to document changes.
